examples.label: Example 1
examples.input:
5 5
cat cot car dog cart
cat cut dot cart ca
examples.display:
words   = ["cat", "cot", "car", "dog", "cart"]
queries = ["cat", "cut", "dot", "cart", "ca"]
output  = [3, 2, 2, 1, 0]

"cat" matches cat, cot and car. "cut" matches cat and cot. "dot" matches cot and dog. "cart" matches only itself, because "car" has another length.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
words   = ["aa", "ab", "ba"]
queries = ["aa", "bb"]
output  = [3, 2]

"bb" is one letter away from "ab" and from "ba", but two away from "aa".
